Definition: to blush; figuratively, to be ashamed, disappointed; causatively, to shame, reproach
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be ashamed, be confounded, be abashed, feel abashed; 1a) (Qal) to be ashamed, be abashed; 1b) (Hiphil) to display shame, demonstrate shame, cause embarrassment
